properties.content: Question: icd 10 cm code for breast cancer Answer: The ICD-10 codes for breast cancer are:: - C50.0: Malignant neoplasm of nipple and areola - C50.1: Malignant neoplasm of female breast - C50.2: Malignant neoplasm of male breast - C50.3: Malignant neoplasm of axillary tail of breast - C50.4: Malignant neoplasm of upper-outer quadrant of breast - C50.5: Malignant neoplasm of lower-inner quadrant of breast - C50.6: Malignant neoplasm of central portion of breast - C50.7: Malignant neoplasm of unspecified site of breast - C50.8: Malignant neoplasm of overlapping sites of breast - C50.9: Malignant neoplasm of breast, unspecified Note: The specific code used will depend on the location and type of breast cancer. For example, C50.4 would be used for a malignant neoplasm in the upper-outer quadrant of the female breast.
properties.formattedContent:
Question: icd 10 cm code for breast cancer

Answer: The ICD-10 codes for breast cancer are::
- C50.0: Malignant neoplasm of nipple and areola
- C50.1: Malignant neoplasm of female breast
- C50.2: Malignant neoplasm of male breast
- C50.3: Malignant neoplasm of axillary tail of breast
- C50.4: Malignant neoplasm of upper-outer quadrant of breast
- C50.5: Malignant neoplasm of lower-inner quadrant of breast
- C50.6: Malignant neoplasm of central portion of breast
- C50.7: Malignant neoplasm of unspecified site of breast
- C50.8: Malignant neoplasm of overlapping sites of breast
- C50.9: Malignant neoplasm of breast, unspecified
Note: The specific code used will depend on the location and type of breast cancer. For example, C50.4 would be used for a malignant neoplasm in the upper-outer quadrant of the female breast.
